description: Arx what outsiders see: the hardening items public scanners (Sucuri SiteCheck and similar) list, per site. status (serviceId): module on or off, the last report (items mixed_content with the pages and where each own-domain http:// link is saved, version_banners, code_folders, csp, headers on apex, www, an error page and a bot, php_eol with the date, object_cache, plus notes firewall_note and home_connection), the last mixed-content fix and its undo, and the CSP state (mode, trial start, enforce readiness, reports, a suggested policy that keeps Stripe, PayPal, Klarna, Paytrail, Google Pay and Apple Pay working). scan: check now (confirm). mixed_fix: change own-domain http:// links saved in posts, post meta, options and theme settings to https:// (confirm; the proposal lists every place; backed up) and mixed_undo puts them back (confirm). csp_report: start a report-only learning policy (confirm; nothing is blocked). csp_trial (policy optional, default the suggestion; providers optional: stripe, paypal, klarna, paytrail, googlepay, applepay): trial that policy report-only (confirm). csp_enforce: enforce the trial policy after a clean report-only period (confirm; refused until the gate says ready; never automatic). csp_off: no CSP header (confirm; the undo). Version banners and theme folders are fixed with oma_arx_security_change apply hide_versions / block_code_folders. enable, disable and fleet are for Lanetti support.

action.description: status is default. Every other action except fleet returns a proposal to confirm. fleet, enable and disable are for Lanetti support.

policy.description: csp_trial: policy to trial report-only (default: the suggestion from status).

providers.description: csp_trial: checkout providers whose sources are added (those seen in reports are added anyway).

serviceId.description: OMA hosting service id (every action except fleet).
